head_commit.message: Add a website-only landing page for Little Say (#8) The website currently opens directly into board setup or the library, without an introduction to Little Say. Add a responsive homepage at `/` that explains picture boards, personal photos and illustrations, multilingual play, optional AI assistance, and offline use. App Store and Google Play placeholders are labeled **Coming soon** and have no active destination. The website links to the browser app at `/app`. Metro selects a separate web entry; native iOS/Android continue opening the shared app and never import the landing page or its styles. Installed web apps open directly into the app, including older standalone installs that still launch at `/`. Existing browser libraries keep the same storage origin. **Stack:** based on #6 (`feat/automatic-card-pictures`), which provides the illustrated-card features described on the page. Merge #6 first, then retarget this PR to `master`. Validation on this isolated PR branch: - `npm run check` passed: release metadata, TypeScript, **179 unit/service tests**, and server/web production builds. - `npm run test:web`: **59 Chromium scenarios passed**, including 1440px/390px/320px layouts, keyboard navigation, disabled store links, direct app entry, legacy standalone launches, and offline reload/playback. - Fresh iOS and Android JavaScript exports succeeded. Source maps include the native entry and contain **zero website sources**. [Bundle audit](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5b9ff9c6d18c7b74e3998d6617e44d24e3c3ae6b/docs/screenshots/website-landing/native-bundle-audit.json). - Documentation and diff checks passed. No signed-device installation or deployment was performed. Screenshots below were captured from this PR's production build at `5b9ff9c`, using illustrative content and no personal data. [All six reviewed screenshots and reproduction instructions](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5b9ff9c6d18c7b74e3998d6617e44d24e3c3ae6b/docs/screenshots/website-landing/README.md). **Desktop homepage · 1440 × 1000** | Phone homepage · 390 × 844 | Phone store section · 390 × 844 | Narrow phone · 320 × 740 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | [Desktop feature overview](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5b9ff9c6d18c7b74e3998d6617e44d24e3c3ae6b/docs/screenshots/website-landing/features-1440.png) · [Phone feature overview](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5b9ff9c6d18c7b74e3998d6617e44d24e3c3ae6b/docs/screenshots/website-landing/features-390.png)
